versions.changelog:
- Initial release of web-video-downloader: a universal web video downloader supporting various streaming formats.
- Automatically detects video sources (direct MP4, M3U8/HLS, segmented MP4, Blob URLs) from any webpage URL and downloads as a complete MP4 file.
- Supports segmented video downloads from platforms like Sohu, Bilibili, and Youku.
- Includes multi-strategy workflow with scripts for CDP network listening and FFmpeg-based merging.
- Handles CDN token renewal, segmented file merging, and blob:URL extraction.
- Provides troubleshooting guide and detailed usage instructions.
